::: {.page-lead}
When I'm away from eye-trackers and computational models, I'm usually chasing light—for fun, not for a portfolio. I shoot 35mm on a [Ricoh KR-5 Super II](https://camera-wiki.org/wiki/Ricoh_KR-5_Super_II){target="_blank"}, often with expired film that surprises me in the wash. I also keep a handful of digital edits when a scene stuck. More of both on my [Flickr](https://www.flickr.com/photos/mohdasti/){target="_blank"}.
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var viewer = document.getElementById("photo-viewer");
  if (!viewer) return;

  var imgEl = document.getElementById("photo-viewer-img");
  var metaEl = document.getElementById("photo-viewer-meta");
  var counterEl = document.getElementById("photo-viewer-counter");
  var allItems = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".photo-gallery-item"));
  var currentGallery = null;
  var currentIndex = -1;

  function itemsInGallery(gallery) {
    return allItems.filter(function (item) {
      return item.getAttribute("data-gallery") === gallery;
    });
  }

  function getItemMedia(item) {
    return item.querySelector(".photo-feature__media img, .digital-card__media img");
  }

  function getItemText(item) {
    return item.querySelector(".photo-feature__text, .digital-card__text");
  }

  function showPhoto(gallery, index) {
    var items = itemsInGallery(gallery);
    if (index < 0 || index >= items.length) return;

    currentGallery = gallery;
    currentIndex = index;
    var item = items[index];
    var thumb = getItemMedia(item);
    var text = getItemText(item);
    if (!thumb || !text) return;

    imgEl.src = thumb.src;
    imgEl.alt = thumb.alt || "";
    metaEl.innerHTML = text.innerHTML;
    counterEl.textContent = (index + 1) + " / " + items.length;

    viewer.hidden = false;
    viewer.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
    viewer.classList.add("is-open");

    allItems.forEach(function (el) {
      el.classList.toggle("is-active", el === item);
    });

    viewer.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
  }

  function closeViewer() {
    viewer.hidden = true;
    viewer.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    viewer.classList.remove("is-open");
    currentGallery = null;
    currentIndex = -1;
    allItems.forEach(function (item) {
      item.classList.remove("is-active");
    });
  }

  document.querySelectorAll(".photo-feature__trigger").forEach(function (trigger) {
    trigger.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      var item = trigger.closest(".photo-gallery-item");
      if (!item) return;
      var gallery = item.getAttribute("data-gallery");
      var index = parseInt(trigger.getAttribute("data-photo-index"), 10);
      if (currentGallery === gallery && currentIndex === index && viewer.classList.contains("is-open")) {
        closeViewer();
      } else {
        showPhoto(gallery, index);
      }
    });
  });

  viewer.querySelector(".photo-viewer__close").addEventListener("click", closeViewer);
  viewer.querySelector(".photo-viewer__nav--prev").addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (!currentGallery || currentIndex <= 0) return;
    showPhoto(currentGallery, currentIndex - 1);
  });
  viewer.querySelector(".photo-viewer__nav--next").addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (!currentGallery) return;
    var items = itemsInGallery(currentGallery);
    if (currentIndex < items.length - 1) showPhoto(currentGallery, currentIndex + 1);
  });

  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
    if (!viewer.classList.contains("is-open") || !currentGallery) return;
    if (event.key === "Escape") closeViewer();
    if (event.key === "ArrowLeft" && currentIndex > 0) showPhoto(currentGallery, currentIndex - 1);
    var items = itemsInGallery(currentGallery);
    if (event.key === "ArrowRight" && currentIndex < items.length - 1) {
      showPhoto(currentGallery, currentIndex + 1);
    }
  });
})();
</script>
```
